name: Perris Plaza

description: Perris Plaza is a convenient neighborhood shopping destination located at 1688 North Perris Boulevard in Perris, California, serving the growing Inland Empire community. This accessible retail center provides local residents with essential shopping and services in a straightforward, easy-to-navigate layout. With extended operating hours from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM, the plaza accommodates busy families and working professionals who need flexible shopping times throughout the day. The center has earned a solid 4.2-star rating from over 3,500 customer reviews, reflecting its role as a reliable community resource. Perris Plaza's strategic location along North Perris Boulevard ensures convenient access for residents throughout the area, making it a practical choice for everyday shopping needs and routine errands.
